services.desc: This tour departs from Oakland Pontiac Airport or pre-arranged from Oakland Troy Airport.This is the longest and most extensive tour we offer. Includes many areas of interest and a mix of places and features in the surrounding area! Due to FAA regulations, this tour is not available during a game, 2 hours before and after a home Major League Baseball game (MLB), National Football League game (NFL) and National Collegiate Athletic Association game (NCAA). Help that special person learn to fly! Our courteous and professional staff provide a supportive, relaxed environment to help them as they learn. We can accommodate virtually any schedule. Enjoy approximately 30 minutes of basic ground
